description: MiniBank demo (synthetic data): Application Insights appi-minibank in workspace law-appmon. Version 1.3: technical failures = HTTP 5xx; business declines (HTTP 409 Insufficient balance) are shown separately and are not failures.

options.content: MiniBankPowered by Azure Arc and Azure Monitor

panels.description: Reads AppRequests and AppAvailabilityResults of minibank-api: the same calls and the same colour rules as the five tiles below (availability and success green from 99.9 %, technical failures green below 1 %, P95 green below 800 ms and red from 1,000 ms). NOW = the last 15 minutes, live, nothing left out: it turns stormy while a fault runs and clears when it ends; business declines (409) are answers, not failures, and never make it rain. LAST 7 DAYS = one tile per day (WIB) with the lab drill minutes left out; days before 13 Nov 2026 were lab build days and are not counted. ERROR BUDGET = the last 7 days (from 13 Nov 2026 14:00 WIB at the earliest), drills left out, against the SLA of this board: 99.9 % of the calls without a technical failure, and 95 % of the calls under 1 second (P95 below 1,000 ms). NEXT 7 DAYS and the heat advisory = the payments speed trend and the dated risks of the Look-ahead risk register (MiniBankLookahead), so the dates match the Look-ahead board. Pinned to now: the time picker does not change this panel. Added 18 Nov 2026 (approved by the lab owner).

panels.title: Service weather: now (last 15 minutes), the last 7 days and the next 7 days  ·  same colour rules as the five tiles below

panels.description: Share of successful runs of the internal availability probe (one transfer per minute from HV-HOST-02).

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppAvailabilityResults
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize AvailabilityPct = round(100.0 * countif(Success == true) / count(), 2)

panels.title: Availability % (probe)

panels.description: Server errors (HTTP 5xx) of all business requests on minibank-api. Business declines such as Insufficient balance (HTTP 409) are not failures.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "minibank-api" and Name !has "health" and Name has "/api/"
| summarize FailureRatePct = round(100.0 * sumif(ItemCount, toint(ResultCode) >= 500) / sum(ItemCount), 2)

panels.title: Technical failures % (5xx)

panels.description: Business declines = Insufficient balance (HTTP 409 INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS) in the selected time range. The background traffic adds about 4 an hour. Not a failure and not in the SLA.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "minibank-api" and Name !has "health" and Name has "/api/"
| summarize Declines = sumif(ItemCount, ResultCode == "409")

panels.title: Business declines

panels.description: SLA: 99.9 % of business requests without a technical failure (HTTP 5xx). Business declines (HTTP 409) do not use the error budget.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "minibank-api" and Name !has "health" and Name has "/api/"
| summarize SuccessPct = round(100.0 - 100.0 * sumif(ItemCount, toint(ResultCode) >= 500) / sum(ItemCount), 3)

panels.title: Success % (SLA 99.9)

panels.description: P95 response time of business requests on minibank-api. SLA target: below 1,000 ms.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "minibank-api" and Name !has "health" and Name has "/api/"
| summarize P95Ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 0)

panels.title: P95 latency ms (SLA 1000)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) and AppRoleName == "minibank-api"
| extend Transaction = case(Name endswith "/api/transfer", "Transfer", Name endswith "/api/qris/pay", "QRIS", Name endswith "/statement", "Statement", Name endswith "/api/login", "Login", "")
| where Transaction != ""
| summarize P95Ms = percentile(DurationMs, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Transaction
| order by TimeGenerated asc

AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) and AppRoleName startswith "minibank-" and Name !has "health"
| summarize Total = sum(ItemCount), Failed = sumif(ItemCount, toint(ResultCode) >= 500) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), AppRoleName
| project TimeGenerated, AppRoleName, FailureRatePct = 100.0 * Failed / Total
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Technical failure rate % by cloud role (5xx)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) and AppRoleName == "minibank-api"
| extend Transaction = case(Name endswith "/api/transfer", "Transfer", Name endswith "/api/qris/pay", "QRIS", Name endswith "/statement", "Statement", Name endswith "/api/login", "Login", "")
| where Transaction != ""
| summarize Requests = sum(ItemCount), TechnicalFailedPct = round(100.0 * sumif(ItemCount, toint(ResultCode) >= 500) / sum(ItemCount), 2), Declines = sumif(ItemCount, ResultCode == "409"), P95Ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 0) by Transaction
| order by Transaction asc

panels.title: Per business transaction: P95, technical failures, declines

azureLogAnalytics.query:
union
 (AppRequests | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) and toint(ResultCode) >= 500 | summarize Count = sum(ItemCount) by AppRoleName, Kind = "Failed requests (5xx)"),
 (AppExceptions | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | summarize Count = sum(ItemCount) by AppRoleName, Kind = "Exceptions")
| where AppRoleName startswith "minibank-"
| order by AppRoleName asc

AppDependencies
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) and Success == false and AppRoleName startswith "minibank-"
| summarize Failed = sum(ItemCount) by AppRoleName, DependencyType, Target, Name, ResultCode
| top 10 by Failed desc

panels.description: Blue: business declines (HTTP 409). Red: technical failures (HTTP 5xx).

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) and AppRoleName == "minibank-api" and Name !has "health" and Name has "/api/"
| summarize ['Business declines (409)'] = sumif(ItemCount, ResultCode == "409"), ['Technical failures (5xx)'] = sumif(ItemCount, toint(ResultCode) >= 500) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Business declines vs technical failures (per 15 minutes)

panels.description: Most recent declines with the trace ID to open in Application Insights (Transaction search).

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) and AppRoleName == "minibank-api" and ResultCode == "409"
| project Time = TimeGenerated, Transaction = case(Name endswith "/api/transfer", "Transfer", Name endswith "/api/qris/pay", "QRIS", Name), Result = "Insufficient balance (409)", DurationMs = round(DurationMs, 0), TraceId = OperationId
| top 20 by Time desc
